title: oenothera biennis var. strigosa
intro: Oenothera biennis var. strigosa, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a biennial plant native to North America, characterized by its fragrant, yellow flowers that bloom in the evening. The health benefits of Evening Primrose include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats. The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose include its ability to modulate prostaglandins, which can help reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an essential fatty acid, as well as other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
